title: docs(skills): a master_detail child is a record-page body table by default
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEoKvgs2TW7hc47KRGVnwtY)_

Fixes #35692

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：照着技能文档写应用的开发者和 AI，会读到新规则：主从子表默认就是记录页概览里的整宽表格，不用再多写一个声明。
- 为什么做：记录页的规则已经上线，技能文档和评测样例还写着旧规则，照着写会多写一个不需要的声明。
- 出错会怎样：只改了文档和评测样例，不影响运行；写错时 AI 可能给出多余或错误的声明，撤回这一个合并即可恢复。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Text only, four files under `skills/` and one changeset. Each changed sentence was checked against `origin/main` at `03bce5c22`.

| Skill sentence (after) | Source on main |
|:---|:---|
| A `master_detail` child with no `relatedList` is a body table | `packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts:62-67`; verdict table rows `related-list-body-table.test.ts:36-40`; `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2129-2134` |
| A `lookup` child with no `relatedList` is a panel | `related-list-body-table.test.ts:31,35`; `field.zod.ts:2134` |
| `'primary'` is the body table on either type | `related-list-body-table.ts:64`; `related-list-body-table.test.ts:34,41` |
| `true` is a panel, also on a `master_detail` | `related-list-body-table.ts:65`; `related-list-body-table.test.ts:42,44` |
| `false` hides the list | `related-list-body-table.test.ts:43,45`; `field.zod.ts:2113` |
| `inlineEdit` governs entry in the parent's form only | `field.zod.ts:2085`; `related-list-body-table.ts:16-18`; test rows 37-40 and 44-45 (the verdict does not move with `inlineEdit`) |
| Body tables are drawn above the field sections | `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:816-821`; `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.bodyTables-27055.test.ts:55-66,84-87` |
| The parent's `relatedLists` orders the tables | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts:428`; `field.zod.ts:2120-2123` |

Files:

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, "Detail-page related lists". The lead sentence states both defaults and that `inlineEdit` plays no part. The example no longer writes `inlineEdit: true` and `relatedList: 'primary'` on a `master_detail` field. The list reads `'primary'` (default for a `master_detail` FK), `false`, `true` (default for a `lookup` FK). The old line 368 said "Default for a `master_detail` FK with `inlineEdit`".
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`, step 2. This is the second place under `skills/` that tied the body table to `inlineEdit` ("the default for a `master_detail` with `inlineEdit`"). The same sentence said the table is drawn "after the first field section"; the merged change draws it above the field sections, so that clause is corrected too. "Put the tasks first" is now the parent's `relatedLists`, and the example field drops `relatedList: 'primary'`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json`, case 1. The prompt is unchanged (`task.lead` is a `master_detail`). The expected answer adds no placement flag. `must_contain` is `relatedListFilter` and `relatedLists`; `must_not_contain` gains `inlineEdit:` (the authored key, so prose that only names it still passes).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md`: the one-line description of that case.

Search for other sentences tying the body table to `inlineEdit`: `git grep -n -i inlineEdit -- skills` gives 20 hits in 10 files; `git grep -n -E "relatedList\b|body table|'primary'|related list" -- skills` was read too. Only the two rules files above carried the old rule. The other `inlineEdit` hits are form-side and stay: `relationships.md` 251-314, `field-types.md:123`, `lint-rules.md:15-18`, `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:55`, `list-views.md:370-371`, `react-blocks.md:76` (a list-view prop), the data eval case 2 and the wizard eval.

## Tests

No package source changes, so there is no build closure owed and no unit test moves. The local readings are gates, run on head `1ea279acf`.

## Acceptance notes

- `relationships.md` lost one true clause to pay for the new text: "owned (`master_detail`) children first" (the derived order when the parent declares no `relatedLists`, `deriveRelatedLists.ts:424-428`). The Order bullet under it still teaches the authored order.
- `relationships.md` 277-281 ("Leave it off for associations ...") is unchanged. Those `master_detail` children are body tables by default now; the `true` and `false` bullets are how an author moves or hides one. No extra sentence was added for it.
- `record-page.md` step 1 still says the tab row is "Overview, Activity, one tab per panel". The synthesizer test in `buildDefaultPageSchema.bodyTables-27055.test.ts:94-97` says no per-list tab is emitted any more. Read only, not measured in a running console, and outside this card.
- An explicit `relatedList: 'primary'` on a `master_detail` field stays valid. The eval does not forbid it.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` case 1: the must and must-not lists decide what a graded answer may contain.
2. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 347-368: the rule as taught.
3. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` 17-27.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `relationships.md is 4198 tokens (ceiling 4203; headroom 5)` and `bundle total (whole shipped tree) 280730`, and exits 0.
